# Vedant Borkute — AI Research and Engineering

> Vedant Borkute's portfolio: original technical writing and projects in AI agents, memory, safety, computer vision, reinforcement learning, and machine learning systems.

Vedant is completing an MS in Computer Science at UC Riverside in December 2026, after a B.Tech in Computer Science at IIT Bombay. The site distinguishes measured experimental results, exploratory investigations, and historical project descriptions. Each project has a linked technical write-up; use the linked article for evidence and limitations rather than inferring results from a title.

## Start here

- [Homepage]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): Background, selected work, and contact.
- [Projects]({{ '/projects/' | absolute_url }}): Complete project index, with links to code, demos, and technical articles.
- [Blog]({{ '/blog/' | absolute_url }}): Full archive of project write-ups and independent research notes.
- [Resume]({{ '/cv/' | absolute_url }}): Experience, education, and selected work.
